semantics: Every label the agentic-layer generator emits is listed here and scored. Gold that fails its own checksum (the invalid twins) stays scored, exactly as in the Kiji validator gold census; the per-label validity split is reported beside it and never replaces it. Layer D lookalike documents carry no gold, so every byte predicted there is a false positive. An unlisted label fails closed, and so does a ruling on a label the generator no longer emits.
